issue_context.title: Ubiquiti UniFi integration fails to refresh the device list after wifi network reconfiguration
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The device list is not refreshed after the list of tracked wireless networks has been altered. The integration correctly removes the device_tracker.* entities, however, it still lists devices it's not tracking anymore.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/332942/130964820-f6b2b6c5-1e3b-4c7a-aea6-57c4b3bb12e7.png)

Steps to reproduce:

1. A Unifi controller manages at least two wireless networks and each network has non-zero devices
2. Configure the Unifi Integration tracking all networks
3. Reconfigure the Unifi Integration tracking only one network
4. Devices from non-tracking networks still appear.  

Expected: Devices from non-tracking networks disappear.



### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.8.8

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

unknown

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Ubiquiti UniFi

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/unifi/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
